subject: maths
prompt_en: A toran design has a mirror line down the middle. If I add a parrot facing left on the left side, what must I add to keep it symmetrical?
prompt_hi: Ek toran design mein beech mein mirror line hai. Agar main baayein taraf baayein dekhta tota lagaun, toh symmetry banaye rakhne ke liye kya lagana hoga?
answer: A parrot facing right, at the same distance from the line on the right side

subject: maths
prompt_en: You fold paper in half and cut a small hole away from the fold. Predict: how many holes will you see when you open it?
prompt_hi: Tum kaagaz ko aadha modkar fold se door ek chhota chhed kaatte ho. Andaaza lagao: kholne par kitne chhed dikhenge?
answer: 2 holes, mirror images of each other

subject: maths
prompt_en: Design A is a 4-petal flower. Design B is a 4-arm pinwheel with bent arms. Both match after a quarter turn. Which one also has mirror lines?
prompt_hi: Design A 4 pankhudiyon wala phool hai. Design B 4 mude hue haathon wali firki. Dono quarter turn par match karte hain. Kismein mirror lines bhi hain?
answer: Only A, the flower; the pinwheel has turn symmetry but no mirror line

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why must repeated motifs be spaced equally for turn symmetry?
prompt_hi: Turn symmetry ke liye dohraaye gaye motifs ko barabar doori par kyun rakhna padta hai?
answer: Each turn must move every motif exactly onto the next one; unequal gaps won't line up

subject: maths
prompt_en: Anu made the right half of a rangoli by copying the left half exactly, with a leaf pointing left on both sides. She says it has a mirror line. Check.
prompt_hi: Anu ne rangoli ka daayan hissa baayein hisse ki hubahu nakal karke banaya, dono taraf patti baayein ki taraf. Woh kehti hai mirror line hai. Check karo.
answer: Wrong: a mirror image flips, so the right leaf should point right

subject: maths
prompt_en: You want a rangoli that matches after a third of a turn. How many copies of your motif do you need?
prompt_hi: Tumhe aisi rangoli chahiye jo ek-tihai turn par match kare. Motif ki kitni copies chahiye?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Design a school logo that has turn symmetry but no mirror line. Describe it.
prompt_hi: Ek school logo design karo jismein turn symmetry ho par mirror line na ho. Use describe karo.
answer: For example 3 curved arms spaced equally around a centre, all bending the same way, like a fan

subject: maths
prompt_en: Describe in words how to make a symmetrical paper toran by folding.
prompt_hi: Shabdon mein batao ki modkar ek symmetrical kaagaz ka toran kaise banate hain.
answer: Fold the strip (in half or zig-zag), cut a shape across the folds, then open it; each fold becomes a mirror line

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Chintu how to make a design that looks the same after every quarter turn.
prompt_hi: Chintu ko sikhao ki aisa design kaise banayein jo har quarter turn ke baad waisa hi dikhe.
answer: Draw a motif, then draw it 3 more times, each turned a quarter turn about the same centre, so there are 4 equally spaced copies

subject: maths
prompt_en: When you fold and cut paper, which line becomes the mirror line?
prompt_hi: Kaagaz modkar kaatne par kaunsi line mirror line banti hai?
answer: The fold

subject: maths
prompt_en: A shape covers 6 full squares and 4 half squares. What is its area?
prompt_hi: Ek shape 6 poore square aur 4 aadhe square gherta hai. Uska area kya hai?
answer: 8 square units

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rectangle has an area of 15 square units and is 5 squares long. How many squares wide is it?
prompt_hi: Ek rectangle ka area 15 square units hai aur woh 5 square lamba hai. Woh kitne square chauda hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: For a rectangle 3 squares long and 2 squares wide, find the area and the perimeter.
prompt_hi: 3 square lambe aur 2 square chaude rectangle ka area aur perimeter nikaalo.
answer: Area 6 square units; perimeter 10 units

subject: maths
prompt_en: A 1 by 5 strip of tiles and a 3 by 3 square of tiles both have a boundary of 12. Predict: do they cover the same space?
prompt_hi: 1 by 5 tiles ki patti aur 3 by 3 tiles ka square, dono ki seema 12 hai. Andaaza lagao: kya dono barabar jagah gherte hain?
answer: No: the strip covers 5 squares and the square covers 9

subject: maths
prompt_en: Compare a 2 by 6 rectangle and a 3 by 4 rectangle. What are their areas and perimeters?
prompt_hi: 2 by 6 rectangle aur 3 by 4 rectangle compare karo. Unke area aur perimeter kya hain?
answer: Both have area 12 square units; perimeters are 16 and 14 units

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why do two half squares count as one square?
prompt_hi: Do aadhe square ek square kyun gine jaate hain?
answer: Two halves put together cover exactly the same space as one whole square

subject: maths
prompt_en: Gauri says the area of a 5 by 3 rectangle is 16 because 5 + 3 + 5 + 3 = 16. What is wrong?
prompt_hi: Gauri kehti hai 5 by 3 rectangle ka area 16 hai kyunki 5 + 3 + 5 + 3 = 16. Kya galat hai?
answer: She found the perimeter; the area is 15 square units (3 rows of 5)

subject: maths
prompt_en: A classroom floor has 8 rows of tiles with 9 tiles in each row. How many tiles cover the floor?
prompt_hi: Ek classroom ke farsh par tiles ki 8 rows hain, har row mein 9 tiles. Farsh par kul kitni tiles?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Dadi's quilt is a big rectangle 6 squares by 4 squares, plus a border of 6 half-square triangles. How many squares of cloth in all?
prompt_hi: Dadi ki godhadi 6 square by 4 square ka bada rectangle hai, saath mein 6 aadhe-square triangles ka border. Kul kitne square kapda?
answer: 27 square units

subject: maths
prompt_en: On squared paper, a right-angled triangle covers exactly half of a 4 by 2 rectangle. What is the triangle's area?
prompt_hi: Squared paper par ek right-angled triangle 4 by 2 rectangle ka theek aadha gherta hai. Triangle ka area kya hai?
answer: 4 square units

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Chintu the difference between area and perimeter using a quilt.
prompt_hi: Chintu ko godhadi ke example se area aur perimeter ka farak sikhao.
answer: Area is how many squares of cloth cover the quilt (the inside); perimeter is the length of lace around its edge (the boundary)

subject: maths
prompt_en: How many unit squares are in a 7 by 2 rectangle?
prompt_hi: 7 by 2 rectangle mein kitne unit square hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Dadi's quilt is 200 cm long and 150 cm wide. How much lace is needed for the border?
prompt_hi: Dadi ki godhadi 200 cm lambi aur 150 cm chaudi hai. Border ke liye kitni lace chahiye?
answer: 700 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: What is the perimeter of a rectangle 8 cm by 5 cm?
prompt_hi: 8 cm by 5 cm rectangle ka perimeter kya hai?
answer: 26 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: A square garden has a perimeter of 36 m. How long is each side?
prompt_hi: Ek square bageeche ka perimeter 36 m hai. Har bhuja kitni lambi hai?
answer: 9 m

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict: if you double both the length and the breadth of a 4 cm by 2 cm rectangle, what happens to the perimeter?
prompt_hi: Andaaza lagao: 4 cm by 2 cm rectangle ki lambai aur chaudai dono double karo, toh perimeter ka kya hoga?
answer: It doubles: from 12 cm to 24 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Compare a 6 cm by 1 cm rectangle and a 5 cm by 3 cm rectangle. Which has the longer boundary?
prompt_hi: 6 cm by 1 cm aur 5 cm by 3 cm rectangle compare karo. Kiski seema lambi hai?
answer: The 5 by 3 rectangle: 16 cm versus 14 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why do we multiply (length + breadth) by 2 for a rectangle's perimeter?
prompt_hi: Rectangle ke perimeter ke liye (lambai + chaudai) ko 2 se guna kyun karte hain?
answer: A rectangle has 2 lengths and 2 breadths; going all the way round you walk each one twice

subject: maths
prompt_en: Rehan says the perimeter of a 7 m by 4 m room is 11 m. Check.
prompt_hi: Rehan kehta hai 7 m by 4 m kamre ka perimeter 11 m hai. Check karo.
answer: Wrong: 11 m is only one length and one breadth; the perimeter is 22 m

subject: maths
prompt_en: On grid paper, Isha counted the squares touching the edge of a 4 by 3 rectangle and got 10 for the perimeter. Check.
prompt_hi: Grid paper par Isha ne 4 by 3 rectangle ki kinaare wali squares gini aur perimeter 10 bataya. Check karo.
answer: Wrong: perimeter counts unit lengths along the edge, 4 + 3 + 4 + 3 = 14

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rectangular park has a perimeter of 50 m and a length of 15 m. What is its breadth?
prompt_hi: Ek rectangle park ka perimeter 50 m hai aur lambai 15 m. Chaudai kitni hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: A farmer fences a 20 m by 12 m field with 3 rounds of wire. How much wire does he need?
prompt_hi: Ek kisaan 20 m by 12 m khet ke chaaron taraf taar ke 3 chakkar lagata hai. Kitna taar chahiye?

subject: maths
prompt_en: You walk around a rectangle drawn on the floor that is 5 steps by 3 steps. Write your walk as an addition.
prompt_hi: Farsh par bane 5 kadam by 3 kadam ke rectangle ke chaaron taraf chalo. Apni chaal ko jod ke roop mein likho.

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Chintu how to find how much lace goes around a rectangular tablecloth.
prompt_hi: Chintu ko sikhao ki rectangle wale tablecloth ke chaaron taraf kitni lace lagegi, kaise nikaalein.
answer: Add all four sides, length + breadth + length + breadth, which is 2 × (length + breadth)

subject: maths
prompt_en: What is the perimeter of a square with sides of 6 cm?
prompt_hi: 6 cm bhuja wale square ka perimeter kya hai?
answer: 24 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: List all the rectangles you can make using all 12 tiles.
prompt_hi: Saari 12 tiles use karke jitne rectangle bana sakte ho, sab batao.
answer: 1 by 12, 2 by 6, 3 by 4

subject: maths
prompt_en: What is the perimeter of a 2 by 6 rectangle of tiles?
prompt_hi: Tiles ke 2 by 6 rectangle ka perimeter kya hai?
answer: 16 units

subject: maths
prompt_en: Which 12-tile rectangle has the shortest boundary?
prompt_hi: 12 tiles wale kis rectangle ki seema sabse chhoti hai?
answer: 3 by 4 (14 units)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict: 16 tiles in a 1 by 16 line or in a 4 by 4 square. Which needs more lace around it?
prompt_hi: Andaaza lagao: 16 tiles 1 by 16 line mein ya 4 by 4 square mein. Kiske chaaron taraf zyada lace lagegi?
answer: The 1 by 16 line (34 units versus 16 units)

subject: maths
prompt_en: A 1 by 12 strip and a 3 by 4 block. Say what is the same and what is different.
prompt_hi: 1 by 12 patti aur 3 by 4 block. Kya same hai aur kya alag?
answer: Same area (12 square units); different perimeters (26 and 14 units)
